scope: authoritative macOS Bridge node readiness for native desktop acceptance

commands.assertions: Bridge returned authoritative host inventory for the connected macOS node.

assertions: The connected macOS node is online and dispatchable but is not a primary arm64 support host.
System remote desktop availability does not establish an interactive user session or capture permission.
The node cannot provide a valid live NAT-04 macOS revoke journey or the required macos-arm64 platform row in its current state.
limitations: No live macOS user-session helper, Accessibility permission, or ScreenCaptureKit capture was exercised.
The device-control scenario could not be started on the node because dependency lifecycle recovery failed while rolling back scenario-authenticator.
